en: Colorized historical postcard showing an ornate fenced monument in a park. At the center stands a statue of a seated man on a pedestal inscribed with "K. E. v. BAER". A person in old-fashioned clothing stands in front of the wrought-iron gate. Tall trees form a leafy background. At the top of the card, red printed text reads "Dorpat." on the left and "Das Baerdenkmal." on the right.
